label: PF Backlog 504
title: Defect: git-CAS reservation ignored existing_max -> remote blocks below local items -> fell back to local (CAS unused)
body:
## Problem / why
The git-remote CAS reservation (BI-PF-0764) reserved blocks from the REMOTE counter only
(``reserved_up_to``), ignoring the item's own ``existing_max``. When local items were already at 7xx/8xx but the
remote counter was at 400, the CAS block ``[401..]`` was BELOW existing_max, so ``_mint``'s guard rejected it and
silently fell back to the LOCAL block. Net: the CAS pushed the counter ref to origin but never drove the ids -
so the shared authority was effectively unused.

## Goal & value
The CAS block must always start above ``existing_max`` so the shared remote is the authority that actually
issues ids (and never behind local items).

## Acceptance criteria
- `_reserve_git(scope, project, size, existing_max)` reserves `max(remote_reserved_up_to, existing_max)+1 .. +N`.
- A reserve with existing_max=500 starts at 501.
- With the remote reachable, add_epic gets its id from the remote CAS (not the local fallback).

## In scope
Pass existing_max into the git-CAS reservation.

## Out of scope
Ongoing re-sync of the remote counter with already-issued local ids (block reservation handles it going forward).

## Verification
test_id_allocator_git still disjoint + inline: existing_max=500 -> block starts 501.
